judge_panel.reason: The reviewer misreads the text. The sentence 'We had to run the module for each value in the range of the mass on the x-axis' is poorly worded, but in context it refers to running CLUMPY for each energy value on the x-axis of the differential flux plots (which are indeed labelled 'Energy [GeV]'). The paper is computing differential flux as a function of energy for fixed DM mass parameters, which is exactly what the figures show. There is no actual contradiction — the x-axis is energy, and the module was run for each energy value to produce the flux spectrum.

The paper states, "We had to run the module for each value in the range of the mass on the x-axis," but the same section/caption says "The mass for the candidate is fixed in each graph" (10 GeV, 500 GeV, 1 TeV), so the description is internally inconsistent with the plotted variable and thus genuinely misleading.

The text in Section 3.1.1 explicitly states 'We had to run the module for each value in the range of the mass on the x-axis,' but the x-axes in the corresponding figures (e.g., Figure 2) are labeled 'Energy [GeV]', confirming the contradiction.
